description: Small deterministic multi-session memory fixture for smoke tests.

records.content: Configured GitHub OAuth through NextAuth. The callback URL must use HTTPS in production.
Fixed a slow post listing query by adding a composite PostgreSQL index on authorId and createdAt.
Resolved flaky Playwright CI by replacing waitForNavigation with waitForURL after form submission.
Kubernetes pods crashed because the secret key was database-url while the deployment expected DATABASE_URL.
